what_it_does: Modern phones increasingly run AI assistants that listen to your voice, understand what you said, generate a response, and speak it back—all on the device itself, without sending audio to distant servers. BROCA is a single-chip computer (System-on-Chip, or SoC) built around the open RISC-V processor design that runs all these tasks with extremely low latency (under 100 milliseconds—so fast you don't notice delay) and minimal battery drain. It combines specialized accelerator circuits for speech processing (like audio signal conditioning), efficient AI inference on quantized (simplified, lower-precision) transformer models, and integrated microphone and speaker interfaces, all optimized so voice responses feel as natural and responsive as talking to someone in the same room.
